children: Oman-based Asyad Shipping has agreed to purchase two medium-range product tankers from South Korea's Hyundai Heavy Industries.
The tankers are valued at OMR40 million ($104 million), the company said in a statement to the Muscat stock exchange.
These two tankers are sister vessels to the six tankers announced in July 2026, the statement added. The contract was valued at OMR119 million.
Each vessel will be deployed on a five-year time-charter contract with a top global energy company, the statement said. The tankers are expected to be delivered in 2029.
The vessels will have a deadweight capacity of approximately 49,999 DWT and are geared toward fuel efficiency.

title: Asyad Shipping awards $104mln contract to Korean shipbuilder
